title: Check a dangerous goods licence
summary: Check the dangerous goods licence status of a driver or vehicle online using the NSW Environment Protection Authority's public register.
intro:
By law, the NSW Environment Protection Authority (EPA) maintains several public registers, including a Dangerous Goods public register.

If you want to check the dangerous goods licence of a driver or a vehicle, you can do this online.
what_you_need: dangerous goods licence number (driver or vehicle)
licence holder name of the individual or company
vehicle registration, if checking a vehicle licence

how_to_steps.text: Select 'Dangerous Goods Driver Licence' from the licence type drop down menu.
Enter the licence information into the search fields.
